title: 出口增长25%：净出口贡献为何变小，内需需加力
speaker: Xiao Jiajue

segments.en: Trade data came out yesterday, 20-25 percent on export growth, high-tech exports, what, 60 percent.
segments.zh: 昨天公布的贸易数据显示出口增长20-25%，高科技产品出口增长60%。

segments.en: That doesn't seem to be at the same economy when you look at what's happening with inflation.
segments.zh: 这与通胀数据反映的经济状况似乎不一致。

segments.en: I think trade growth, I think especially in the headlines are really very much driven a lot of the pressing effect, but then we still see that the voting growth in export is still expanding, especially for those green products related exports.
segments.zh: 贸易增长受基数效应推动，但出口量仍在扩张，尤其是绿色产品相关出口。

segments.en: For example, these auto, for example, and other things that, and also we are seeing some rebound in those traditional consumer goods out of China as well, as China's exports to the US also rebounded, benefiting from a very low comparison base last year.
segments.zh: 例如汽车等产品，以及传统消费品出口也有所回升，对美出口因去年低基数而反弹。

segments.en: So, trade growth is 25 percent, input growth is 28 percent, so that means we probably see that on the net contribution to growth basis, even the trade supply remains very large.
segments.zh: 出口增长25%，进口增长28%，净出口对增长的贡献可能减小。

segments.en: We still see a smaller contribution to growth, that means China, even indeed, want to achieve annual growth target of 4.5 to 5 percent, China needs to do more in terms of boosting the domestic demand growth.
segments.zh: 净出口贡献减小，要实现4.5%-5%的增长目标，中国需要更多提振内需。
